input.query: SELECT channel, variant, count(*) AS n_subjects, avg(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS conversion_rate_14d, avg(margin_60d_eur) AS avg_margin_60d_net_bonus_eur, avg(bonus_cost_eur) AS bonus_cost_per_user_eur FROM fct_experiment_users WHERE experiment_id = 'topup10_2026q1' GROUP BY channel, variant ORDER BY channel, variant
